sources.title: MIVUBI Player Permission Gamemode and Developer Access Policy v1

facts.subject: developer access
facts.statement: Developer/admin access must be an explicit, auditable capability separate from gameplay role, arena membership, scoreboard tags, or gamemode. Do not infer dev authority merely from Creative, Operator, a tag, or proximity to a dev area.

facts.subject: developer command surface
facts.statement: Custom developer commands should use the minimum command permission level that excludes unintended callers and command blocks where appropriate. Debug/admin commands must not default to Any or broad GameDirectors unless intentionally required.

facts.subject: developer command targeting
facts.statement: Developer operations such as skip level, force start, reset arena, teleport, grant kit, kill entities, or load structures must require explicit arena/player scope and generation validation. Broad @a/@e dev commands are prohibited unless intentionally global.

facts.subject: temporary gamemode change
facts.statement: Temporary gameplay gamemode changes such as Spectator for chunk loading/cutscenes or Creative for dev workflows must be owned by a scoped lease with original state, reason, session generation, arena generation, and restore policy.

facts.subject: spectator participation
facts.statement: Spectator mode is excluded by default from active/ready/alive/interactable participant predicates unless the game mode explicitly opts in. Gamemode alone does not prove participation, but Spectator should trigger scrutiny for gameplay interactions.

facts.subject: player control authority
facts.statement: Permission level, command permission, gamemode, and input permissions are independent state surfaces and must be reconciled separately. Restoring one must not be treated as proof the others are correct.

facts.subject: reconnect access state
facts.statement: On reconnect or new session generation, revalidate runtime permission/gamemode/input state against current project policy. Do not blindly restore transient dev/gameplay privileges from stale session state.

facts.subject: production debug tooling
facts.statement: Production-targeted packs should maintain an explicit debug-surface registry for dev commands, bypass tags, hidden buttons, admin items, debug scoreboards, and test-only command blocks, with release checks that flag unintended enabled surfaces.

facts.subject: operator status
facts.statement: Operator or command permission level may authorize developer actions but must not become gameplay authority for arena membership, team role, scoring, readiness, or winner determination.

facts.subject: post-arena permission baseline
facts.statement: Arena cleanup/player normal form must verify intended permission level, command permission policy, gamemode, input permissions, flight/spectator state, and removal of temporary dev/gameplay bypass markers before reuse.

facts.subject: developer action audit
facts.statement: High-impact dev/admin actions should emit compact audit evidence containing actor identity, permission basis, target arena/player, generation, action, and result so test interventions are distinguishable from organic gameplay transitions.
